content: ExecutionTime . softwareContext The Software- Context is the logical context for which the ExecutionTime is given. This includes two aspects: 1. the values of the input-parameters to the software 2. the state the logic of the runnable depends on In the current form, both attributes are of type String and can contain free-form text describing this state.
